txt: *I'm* all you have? Then you truly lost it all, brother. You let the world drag it all away from you, and what it left, you pissed away -- and here we are.
*Snap!* The knot is slashed. Another cut and the belt falls apart like a flower bouquet, revealing the dead man's neck -- and the dark red ligature mark around it.
A black trickle of liquid runs into his throat from the wound...
A cargo belt twists his neck at an unnatural angle. The body below appears stiff. It's letting out an ungodly rot, the smell seeps in even through your clenched nostrils.
A killer. A motherfucker and a killer.
A pool of blood and faeces has eaten into the frozen mud below the man's feet. Purge liquid is dripping into it, drop by drop.
A really, really bad smell is coming from there now. And... some kind of cracking sound.
A small bell-like sound fills the air. Like tapping on the side of a porcelain cup.
A small flower of metal blossoms from the man's head, followed by your finger.
A tiny tear forms on your duct. The corpse stinks from the blackened bullet hole in his chest. A single drop of decay liquid runs out of it, then down his stomach...

A vision of black and dark red death, pried open by your naked hands and studded with teeth. Looks like he's laughing, death fumes rising from the throat. And there, in the back of his mouth, above the bell of the uvula, right in the soft palate...
Above those -- an eleven field info form needs filling out first. It begins with:

An intricate web of blue lines stretches across the torso. From the right shoulder to the solar plexus, each time they intersect a small white star is formed in their crossing. Hundreds of fading asterisks riddle his skin, their concentration is highest around his heart.
An intricate web of blue lines stretches across the torso. If you want to re-examine the tattoos, looking at the photo would give you a better, more detailed view.
As you narrow your eyes, the monster before you blurs into a violent mess of green and pink.
Ask me more questions? You fucking *love* questions.
Because you *have*.
Because you're a copparooni. Look at all of them go! Do you want more questions?
Before you can grab hold of the boot, you hear a voice coming out of the dead man's mouth. It's the voice of Lieutenant Kim Kitsuragi, telling you to stop whatever you're doing.
Below the note, two boxes wait to be ticked. The dead man's head jerks to the side -- awaiting your judgement. The ring around his neck is visible.
Between you and me, your name is probably Harry.
But *what* other options? The corpse twists on the belt, like chicken on a skewer...
But there is no breath to catch -- only the cadaver filling the air and your nostrils. He slowly rotates before you, decomposing.
Captain Coppodromo, I fear we are drifting away, fixating on sexuality again... let's go with a simpler question.
Coagulated blood sticks to his scalp and chest -- where the countless stones have hit the dead man. Beneath the description of injury, two boxes:
Comin' right up, copporooni Roonie. This is getting up-beat now!
Communism.
Dark brown hair grows on his head, his face is ready to explode from the organic processes inside. The death's head grin has passed, what remains is an unrecognisable mess.
Decay is creeping on the tattoo, already most of the canvas that's holding it has darkened, now it disintegrates slowly, letting out a stink...
Do I look like an erotic auto-asphyxiation type to you?
Do I remind you of someone?
Do you need the assistance of private security services? Cobo, I'm afraid even *we* can't protect you from what's after you... The Great Shadow.
Doesn't feel like anything. A cold spot under your gardening gloves, unremarkable and un-alive.
Doesn't feel like anything. Just cold flesh under your finger, unremarkable and un-alive.
Faint, organic lines cover the plates where they separate into smaller ones. These plates then divide into smaller plates, until there are hundreds of them altogether...
For a moment, the hanged man appears to smile. His lips are red like a clown's.
For a quarter of a second he appears to be looking at you. The stench of death makes your eyes well up.
Fuck it hard, Copopo the Clown.
Fuck no, you're no Roonie.
Go ahead, Cobo.
Go ahead, ask me more questions. You fucking *love* questions.
Good for you.
Good. Death does not care for your smart alecking. It reeks and disintegrates in a feast for cadaverine bacteria.
Hah! The clown lips on the corpse appear to smile. The face rotates before you, slowly...
Hah! The clown lips on the corpse appear to smile.
He *loves* those.
He's too heavy to move by yourself -- a great mass of dead muscles, with hoarfrost covering his milky eyes.
Here you go, you loonie!
His eyes are milky white and blind to the world, protruding comically from their sockets. There is no one home, just sub-aquatic terrors there.
His face. His cheeks, his nose, his fat swollen lips. Like a spider, your hand crawls over his features. Everything is silent.
His fingernails have turned dark. They're chipped and quite long. There is dirt under them. That's all.
His hair feels wet, soaked with rain, cold to touch. Not that different from a living person -- after a swim.
Huh?
I did, Cobo, I did. Reminded me of when I was just a small boy. Before *this* happened to my face and my body. You did me a kindness there.
I know what this means -- more questions.
I like it a *lot* brother. This really is your finest hour! You're a genius -- a regular Coppolangelo!
I'm a joke. Look at me.
I'm gone.
I'm only fucking with you! I know where you're from -- from Coppodocia! And your name is *Il Cobo*. What can I do you for, Il Cobo di Coppodocia?
IMAGINATION.
In the past. Way out west.
Inside the icy realm of the ice bear fridge, the corpse stands slumped, waiting...
Inside you see darkness. Just a mess of meat and darkness.
Into the wild pale yonder.
It feels dry. Nothing comes out of you as you stretch and bend your face into a crying shape. You're too furious to cry, apparently.
It feels like the leg is going to come off along with the boot, but you are able to get the boot to move a centimetre or two.
It's *all* right.
It's a mish-mash, Coppobollo. You think I'm Messinian, don't you? For you, this is how people from Messina speak like.
It's hard, but somehow you manage not to see it. The corpse looks at you sideways, from an unnatural angle.

It's hard. You taste stomach acid in the back of your throat. A contraction -- your throat pumps a little something from your stomach and into your mouth. You're forced to swallow, just to keep looking...
It's heavier than you'd think. You're forced to drop it back down immediately. The corpse lands on the ground with a nauseating thud, looking even sadder than before.
It's not completely useless. You're able to reveal a little more of the putrid polymer sock beneath the boot.
It's the power of your... (Black, frothy liquid starts bubbling on his lips...)
Just a small gulp away, my beloved Cobo. A small gulp away.
KK57-0503-0815 listens, motionless -- with the cargo belt still around his neck. Only one box remains:
Listen to yourself... You're not a Raphaël anything. You're probably just Harry or something. That's right... *Harry*.
Little black bubbles pop on the corpse's lips, decay liquid like tar. It's like he's gurgling.
Looking at my face, motionless. Looking into my eyes. Standing here. Why are you investigating my murder?
Love did me in, brother Coppo. It was love all along...
Maybe I was getting my rocks off?
More hair sticks to the glove -- hair off the rain soaked head of a dead man. There are bumps and dips on the skull below. An alien landscape.
More hair sticks to your hand -- hair off the rain soaked head of a dead man. There are bumps and dips on the skull. An alien landscape.
No scream, no sigh of relief rises from the darkness inside. It's humid there, sickly sweet air unlike anything living. You feel like throwing up, straight in that mouth...
No, not quite... Be fair now.
No, you don't. Between you and me, your name is probably Harry.
No, you're not a Harry either. You're a motherfucker. That's who you are, Roonie the Motherfucker.
No. My hair is too light a shade of brown. My eyebrows too. Trust your inner racist.
Nor does he look male, with his pregnant belly and indistinguishable face.

Not good. Let's pin this on the bear -- the ice bear tore up his legs with its claws. As for the boots -- you can't possibly do anything with them until you have cleaned and *disinfected* them thoroughly.
Nothing is as nothing does! This was pleasurable. I sincerely thank you for touching my hand.
Of course you did, you question-lover.
Of course! You have questions, don't you? The power of your *imagination* is at your service.
Oh yes, Cobo mi Lobo! In the gift horse's mouth, tracts and wakes and waterways! Ancient materials buried...
Only the little one fits. The flesh changes shape as you bore in, searching for something in the cartilage.
Only the lower extremities are pink with a dash of blue: his fatted hands, thighs and his neck, just above the noose. The rest of the corpse appears dark green in the cold spring air.
Pleased to meet you. Where are you from and what's your name?
Shoot, Loonie Roonie!
Something cracks in the left leg -- it really is about to come off. The leg, I mean. Not the boot.
Sure I do -- you just don't want to admit it.
Sure, Lobo, I can ask you a question: Why are you doing this?
Sure. The corpse looks by, oblivious. Black decay liquid drops from his knee to his boot.
That you have, Cobo, that you have! We're real tight that way. In that special, special way...
That's right. Stupid, boring Harry. Harry the Motherfucker.
The basal ganglia feels clumpy -- what entered here has torn apart his reptilian complex.
The belt is equally tight around the whole circumference of his neck, swelling over the edges like white bread, rising from the yeast.
The blue heart? Oh, that's good shit, you'll love it. Just press down and *fuck* it open like you always do.

The body is heavier than you expected -- and stinkier. It takes half an hour to get it down to the basement, then ten more minutes to stuff it into the fridge. The lieutenant takes a step back to admire your handiwork.
The body is reluctant to let go of the boots -- as though they were its last bit of dignity.
The buckle comes into focus in your sights. You stand with your feet planted firmly in the ground and your left hand supporting your gun arm...
The cadaver hangs from the cargo belt --limbs limp and torso covered in tattoos.
The cadaver slowly twists on the cargo belt, his torso covered in tattoos and extremities blotched pink and blue.
The cartilage gives in with a crack, like some fruit. Just like that your hand is in his head. Strange fluid streams down your wrist -- and then you feel it, with the tip of your finger...
The cold piece of bakelite and gunmetal is surprisingly light. Your finger fits right through the guard, instinctively resting on the trigger.
The corpse appears to laugh at you, black froth bubbling on it's lips. Every molecule in this body reeks of death. It's *still* too much, you feel it coming up again...
The corpse cannot feel Kim's hand on his chest. It no longer meaningfully interacts with its surroundings. A thicket of boxes and lists on red copier paper tries to answer *why*:
The corpse does not object, he lies slumped to the side stinking. The ground underneath him is saturated in purge liquids.
The corpse is indifferent to time of the Dead Light and Great Culling, just lies there. The next box says:
The corpse is indifferent to your scribblings, just lies there. The next box says:
The corpse is silent. The nose in the middle of his face is swollen, so are his cheeks. His lips are motionless.
The corpse lays slouched to the side, oblivious to its surroundings. The field autopsy form describes his state in three parts:
The corpse lies on the ground among the remains of an absolutely *demolished* pinewood branch. It's gently laid on one side.
The corpse lies there, indifferent to your retrograde amnesia. The next box says:
The corpse looks *enormous* with its bloated belly. Was the ice bear fridge really that giant? You should go and measure it, just to be sure.
The corpse looks ageless, like meat on a hook.
The corpse looks at no particular direction with its bulging eyes. Its mouth is silent.
The corpse looks at you with bulging white eyes. The face around them does not look human, it's swollen and ready to burst. His lips are fishlike and his tongue like a ball gag in his mouth.
The corpse looks at you with mute, liquefying eyes. A dark froth-like liquid has gathered on his lips. It's sickening.
The corpse looks right through you as you distance yourself from its stench, eyes like a shark...
The corpse seems to yawn contentedly, as though its glad you've run out of steam.
The corpse with his pants down does not have an opinion on the subject. All he has is genitals and a deathly odour.
The dead man looks too, with barely contained excitement to hear the moral of his story.
The dead man stares in silence as you crack open the ledger. The bright red paper is covered in boxes and lists -- describing the condition of his skin and organs in three parts.

The dead man's penis is average-sized, congested from the downward collection of blood. The testicles are uneven in length, hanging underneath. The genitalia is greenish; marbling is present around the crotch.
The glassy-eyed corpse looks by, his mouth mute and his skin as colourful as the chemical rainbow on the photo paper, teeming with opportunistic organisms.
The hair under your latex fingers feels cold to touch, wet.
The hand feels heavy, filled with decay liquids. Like it's ready to explode, if squeezed hard enough. You're suddenly repulsed -- so much so you feel compelled to drop it.
The hand is surprisingly heavy to lift, filled with decay liquids. Feels as though it could explode, if squeezed harder. You're suddenly repulsed -- so much so you feel compelled to drop it.
The hanged man lets out a joyous little bubble of rot from his nose...
The hangman's knot is pulled tight by the weight of the corpse below. Yellow, hard-edged polyester cuts into his neck. Above, a sliding buckle ties the belt to the branch.
The inside of the head feels cold and smooth like a glove as you pull out, sweat dripping down your brow -- careful not to lose the prize between your fingers...
The legs look like they've been clawed at by wild animals. As for the boots -- you can't possibly do anything with them until you have cleaned and *disinfected* them thoroughly.

The man before you is naked, but for a pair of underpants and enameled boots. His skin is greenish, marbled with decaying veins and blotched by lividity. A fading web of tattoos covers his chest and shoulders. The cargo belt used to fasten him to the branch above appears industrial in strength.

The man before you is naked, but for a pair of underpants and white boots. His skin is marbled with decaying veins and blotched by lividity. On his chest: a fading web of tattoos. The cargo belt used to hang him from the tree looks reinforced.

The material appears to be ceramic. Its clean white stands in stark contrast to the decaying flesh above the knee. The man wore thick polymer socks, probably for padding. A fine array of interlocking plates covers them.
The metal connects with the same *ding*. The sound does not appear to get louder...
The monster comes back into focus: an explosion of colour, coursing with dark marbled veins. His stomach appears pregnant with something -- black liquid streams down his thigh and onto his boot.
The oral cavity is cold and moist. A ball-like tongue attaches itself to the base of the mouth, lolling around like a scallop...
The pale, Coppo... it spooks me out.
The pudgy mess looks neither *Mondial* nor *Occidental*. It doesn't even look human. The next line says:
The pudgy mess of curdled meat looks neither *Mondial* nor anything other.
The rotting man lies on his side with his eyes looking straight through you. The belt is still around his neck, his body is supine and open to intrusion by autopsy.
The sabatons dangle off the man's decaying form, ageless and synthetic.
The stench fills your nostrils. As you push downward, an ominous creaking sound comes from above.
The stench is suffocating. Strands of dark brown hair start sticking to the latex of the glove -- like thread off a rag doll's head.
The stench is suffocating. Strands of dark brown hair start sticking to your hand, like thread off a rag doll's head.

The tongue moves freely in the cavity. The mucous of the mouth is slippery, delicate to touch. From the soft meat -- teeth are budding; hard pearls of bone in the gums. And in the back of the mouth...
Then the *rigor* in his muscles gives up, and he smashes sideways into the spring mud, letting out a horrid stench.
There go those beautiful enamel boots. May they rest in Processing...
There go those beautiful enamel boots. You will never own the full set now. May they rest in Processing...
There he still is -- looking right through you with his white eyes. The body below is entirely dedicated to that corpse smell. Emitting it is *all* it does now.
There is nothing funny about jokes, either.
There you go -- look at that bright kid! We're birds of a feather, you and I. Soon you will be just like me, just keep drinkin' and havin' a good time. It's a matter of weeks.
There's a tiny crack, a protrusion in the cranium, right in the back of his head. Your finger must be pointing straight at it. From the *inside*.
They are swollen shut -- you need to really *push* to get in.
This is the right method. It takes some time, but eventually the boots come off -- with nasty slices of polymer sock stuck to even bigger pieces of skin and rotting flesh.
VERMILLION, in yellow letters along the length of the twisting cargo belt. Only a deep longing for Vermillion *Golden Spirits* lets you decipher the fading logo of the local brewery.
We should do this more often. Be close like this, I mean.
Well, I'm not *from* Messina, am I? My hair is too light a shade of brown. Trust your inner racist.
What do you mean?
Where a ripe corpse still hangs from the tree, spotted with green and purple.
Where the ripe corpse of a man still lies on the ground, spotted with green and purple.
With a *plop*, your hand emerges from the mouth, covered in blood up to the wrist. Between your fingers -- a small flower, a blossom made of lead!
With your hand numb from the recoil, you look at the body slump down. For a moment the man appears to *kneel* in front of you.
Yeah, well, he seems to think I'm also a racist since I have tattoos and a military body build. It's called *profiling*.
Yes. That's what this part is called.
You *get* me, Cobo. I feel like you were once for tenderness and kisses yourself... but then shit went *south* and now you're ahead of even me on the pain front!
You ain't no Tequila Sunset, you're probably just Harry or something. That's right... *Harry*.
You can almost see the body decomposing before your very eyes. You should drop everything else and look for a way to preserve it so you can conduct your examination better.
You can be anything you wanna be, brother Coppo.
You can come back and look into this face any time you want. Ask me your little questions, freshen your memory. Create associations, remind yourself of your *mortality*, Coppolopo.
You can feel it coming up again. The corpse twirls in the wind.
You manage to suppress the contractions trying to empty your stomach -- all it takes is concentration. Through it, you see nothing but darkness. More meat and darkness...
You might be on to something there.
You missed the belt, but hit the corpse straight in the chest. Bits of ribcage protrude from the skin. No blood, only a murky sludge dripping down his belly. The sudden stink makes your eyes water.
You pick it between your fingers. The mass feels large, very porous somehow. Keep crawling, lest you break it...
You pull down his breeches. Marbling is present around the crotch. The penis has shrunk, crawling half way back inside him. There is nothing mysterious or noteworthy here.
You seem to be holding your breath.
You sure wriggled out of that one, Coppolini!
You think I am. You think I was a racist because this lump looks like military and has tattoos. That's called *profiling*.
You're a lying sack of shit, coppo. You're doing this because there is *nothing* else to do. Everything else is over. It's just *me* now.
You're misquoting me, Roonie. I said communism killed me. Love *DID ME IN*.
You're sabotaging the crime scene, and yet you haven't even finished the field autopsy. Come back later when you're done with the investigation.
Your field of view narrows. The branch slowly moves, becoming entirely two-dimensional. The metal buckle glimmers as the corpse slowly rotates.
Your field of view narrows. The branch slowly moves, becoming entirely two-dimensional. The metal buckle glimmers, catching the evening light as the corpse slowly rotates.
Your field of view narrows. The branch slowly moves, becoming entirely two-dimensional. The metal buckle glimmers, catching the morning light as the corpse slowly rotates.
Your field of view narrows. The branch slowly moves, becoming entirely two-dimensional. The metal buckle glimmers, catching the noon light as the corpse slowly rotates.
Your field of view narrows. The branch slowly moves, becoming entirely two-dimensional. The metal buckle glimmers, slick with the falling rain. The corpse slowly rotates...
Your fingers are all the way in now, reaching toward the inside of his skull. The cavity goes further, but the entry wound isn't wide enough for the rest of your hand to follow...
Your fingers reach toward his skull. His cerebral cortex feels like jelly -- cold jelly -- strange fluid streams down your wrist as you push deeper. Until you feel it, on the tip of your finger...
Your fingers slide into the remains of his limbic system. There is no resistance. It's gelatinous. The slug-like structures are damaged too, the tearing extends deep into both hemispheres.
Your fist connects to the boot with the same *ding*. The sound does not appear to get louder.
Your index fits right in there. A tight tunnel of flesh opens up -- tissue damage -- wide enough for two fingers. As you push both in, you reach through his mouth, right into his brain stem.
Your loss, *coppodoppo*. Would've been so primo...
